positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Hands on design and code along with a team of developers.
Guide team development efforts towards successful project delivery. 
Provide technical leadership to teammates. 
Maintain high standards of software quality within the team by establishing good practices. 
Identify and encourage areas for growth and improvement within the team.
Design, develop, and unit test applications in accordance with established standards.
Develop, refine, and tune integrations between applications. 
Supervise the DBA Team.
positions.insights: Skills: Technical Architecture · Agile Methodologies · Technical Reviews · Troubleshooting · TypeScript · Python (Programming Language) · Software Design · C#

positions.title: Senior Oracle Application Developer
positions.description: Hands on participation on a variety of web applications for several purposes such as a cross application user administration API, Deals Management, Vendor Portal, Price Update / Verification / Label printing (formatted for hand held), Price Management, Ad Preparation, Interfaces for NCR and IBM POS, and more. Developed also shell scripting applications for loading data, executing interfaces with specific business rules, and monitoring purposes. In addition, Worked in PL-SQL for creating interfaces for several databases, back-end processes for data transformation, concurrent fixes, and reporting.
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Technical Reviews · Troubleshooting · Python (Programming Language) · Software Design · C#

positions.title: Sr. Engineer
positions.description:
● Oracle PL - SQL instructor.
● Develop tools to improve and speed up the OGS team common tasks using Oracle PL-SQL, Java and Shell Scripting.
● OMS & CRM systems support and troubleshooting
positions.insights: Skills: Agile Methodologies · Troubleshooting · TypeScript · Software Design
